test.create_query: CREATE TABLE vq_768 (id UInt32, vec Array(BFloat16) CODEC(Quantized('rabitq', 768))) ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY id
CREATE TABLE vq_136 (id UInt32, vec Array(BFloat16) CODEC(Quantized('rabitq', 136))) ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY id
test.fill_query: INSERT INTO vq_768 SELECT number, arrayMap(i -> toBFloat16((toInt64(sipHash64(number, i) % 2001) - 1000) / 1000.), range(768)) FROM numbers_mt(1000000) SETTINGS max_threads = 8, max_insert_threads = 8

INSERT INTO vq_136 SELECT number, arrayMap(i -> toBFloat16((toInt64(sipHash64(number, i) % 2001) - 1000) / 1000.), range(136)) FROM numbers_mt(1000000) SETTINGS max_threads = 8, max_insert_threads = 8
test.query: SELECT id FROM vq_768 ORDER BY cosineDistance(vec, arrayMap(i -> toBFloat16(sin(i)), range(768))) LIMIT 10 SETTINGS vector_search_use_quantized_codes = 1, vector_search_index_fetch_multiplier = 1 FORMAT Null

SELECT id FROM vq_136 ORDER BY cosineDistance(vec, arrayMap(i -> toBFloat16(sin(i)), range(136))) LIMIT 10 SETTINGS vector_search_use_quantized_codes = 1, vector_search_index_fetch_multiplier = 1 FORMAT Null
